categories.label: Setting
categories.note: What sits behind them, at this distance

items.t: A plain studio backdrop in one colour.
A textured paper backdrop, lit unevenly.
A window behind them, the room dark by comparison.
A kitchen, close enough to read one or two objects.
A workshop, tools softly out of focus.
A street at night, lights thrown out of focus.
A vehicle interior, seen from the passenger seat.
Nothing behind them at all: flat colour.
